title: Home Oxygen Therapy Return, Pickup and Recovery Terms
content:
# Return, Pickup and Recovery Terms — Home Oxygen Therapy

## Terms

1. A patient may decline Home Oxygen Therapy before delivery at no charge.
2. Equipment is returned only at the patient's own confirmation of a return pickup request: oxygen equipment is returned only after a return pickup request on this oxygen record is approved. The basis is the system record: the request type, its status and the oxygen record it is filed on.
3. Pickup is made within the class's pickup lead time in business days of the confirmation.
4. > Clause retired in part: "billing stops with the last month that began before the return." This clause is no longer in force for a return closed on the confirmation, by the patient or the patient's representative, of the return of equipment that is no longer needed. Every other return remains under this clause.
5. Equipment recovered damaged beyond normal wear is charged the class's damage fee.
6. Each cylinder not recovered is charged the class's per-cylinder charge.
7. A stationary system still not recovered the class's unrecovered-equipment days after the confirmed pickup date is charged the class's unrecovered-equipment charge.
8. A charge is removed when the item is later recovered.
9. A return because the patient died is never charged for damage or missing items.

## Charges at a glance

| Event | Charge |
|---|---|
| Declining oxygen before delivery | none |
| Recovered damaged beyond normal wear | the class's damage fee |
| Cylinder not recovered | the class's per-cylinder charge, for each cylinder |
| Stationary system not recovered after the unrecovered-equipment days from the confirmed pickup date | the class's unrecovered-equipment charge |
| Item later recovered | the charge is removed |
| Return because the patient died | never charged for damage or missing items |

## Hypothetical cases

- A stationary system with a hypothetical confirmed pickup date of 1 May and a 30-day figure is charged if still not recovered 30 days after 1 May; if it is recovered afterwards, the charge is removed.
- A return because the patient died with one cylinder missing carries no charge for the missing cylinder.
